item.title: Override docker-compose.yml files
item.description:
Sometimes we want to have different versions of docker-compose.yml files (one for production and one for development). Each environment has their own characteristics (slightly different images for example) we show here a good way to override sections of a docker-compose.yml file easily.

Why?

Sometimes we have several environments that share almost all docker configuration. Having a common docker-compose.yml file and several docker-compose.override.yml files is a great way to manage your service configurations.
